operation: Run structural and relational checks plus four failure injections, and write a report without overwriting history.
steps: Confirm the report path does not already contain a different historical run.
Run the checker with failure injection and capture the log.
Compare report hashes with the files actually on disk.
Record every rejection and every check that could not run.
acceptance_checks: Exit code and report status agree.
Each injected defect is rejected with its expected code.
The report separates schema success from coverage completeness.

on_failure.retry: Return to the domain task named by the failing entity and fix the evidence.
on_failure.stop: Stop when a required check cannot run and report the unverified status instead of a pass.
